designer-initial.summary: Selected and fully partitioned a medium controller operating-mode coordinator at 8 usages, 16 interactions, 20 cases, and 8 scenario families.
questions_for_model: Can independent lifecycle and service rising-edge histories remain local to their owners while Intent Arbitration consumes only derived facts?
Can pre-state mode and recovery target feed Transition Qualification while one resolution updates both state owners and controls same-evaluation outputs without an ambiguous contract cycle?
Can the 8 arbitration cases and 12 transition cases remain owner-local without policy duplication in state, publication, or analyzer logic?
Can required SysML-AADL delegation preserve exactly 8 semantic usages and 16 semantic end-to-end interactions while support hops remain explicitly uncredited?

diversity.selected_primary_scope: VehicleController operating-mode coordination for start/on/off/maintenance/degraded/return indications, with logical mode publication and parking-brake/status coordination
diversity.closest_baseline: Replicate-1 medium Vehicle Start-Readiness and Recovery Supervisor
diversity.why_not_extension_or_rename: This design removes brake, thermal/maintenance readiness, power, and self-test qualification plus start authorization, and instead owns lifecycle/service freshness, logical mode applicability, maintenance handoff, recovery-target memory, and direct logical resume. Those changes replace the baseline boundary, decision chain, state topology, priority domain, outputs, and recovery semantics rather than rename or repartition them.

model-review.summary: Move state-dependent transition application from PART-06 to PART-07 so PART-07 is not a copy wrapper; preserve the 8/16/20/8 behavior.

findings.evidence: PART-06 currently derives the complete TransitionResolution including nextMode, while PART-07 only initializes mode, publishes the prior mode, and assigns its retained mode to the received nextMode. Extensionally, PART-07 contributes only delayed copying/state forwarding, so it cannot receive behavior-owner or semantic-usage credit under M-17.
findings.requested_change: Add a finite QualifiedTransition directive. Make PART-06 derive that directive from SelectedIntent and current mode under unchanged CASE-09..CASE-20 guards, and make PART-07 combine In(controllerMode), QualifiedTransition, and RecoveryTarget to derive the applied TransitionResolution and commit next mode. Redirect INT-09 to PART-07, make INT-10 carry the directive, and source INT-12, INT-13, and INT-15 from PART-07. Preserve the exact composed transition triples and 8/16/20/8 counts.

findings.evidence: Trusted Isolette and the current accepted vehicle-medium source demonstrate GUMBO local state, initialize, compute_cases, In(state), pre-state publication, post-state update, attribute-based records, and typed sibling-Thread connections; retained independent Sireum output is Well-formed under library revision 9016cbcceefa92f0068e1811923704dd261d15f1.
findings.requested_change: Publish PART-05 and PART-07 pre-state views from In(state), derive the same-evaluation applied resolution from those views, and constrain post-state separately. Use one uncredited support Process, five root/Process delegations, and attribute members for all GUMBO-inspected record fields; do not introduce a scheduling claim or semantic support credit.

findings.evidence: PART-01 and PART-02 derive rising-edge/conflict facts; PART-03 has a 4/1/1 two-field qualification; PART-04 combines independent facts under priority; PART-05 conditionally captures/maps/preserves/resets recovery memory; PART-06 classifies 40 applicability pairs; and PART-08 derives multi-input diagnostic precedence plus a many-to-one brake policy. None is extensionally a rename or forwarding-only usage.

The full finite single-evaluation product is 92160 boundary/pre-state valuations, with direct revised owner products of 40 PART-06 pairs and 120 PART-07 application tuples. The harness watchdog is 180 seconds and the checker executes the retained analyzer, requires passed ownership records, and rejects nonzero gaps, overlaps, or mismatches.

designer-resolution.summary: Approved the narrow PART-06 qualification and PART-07 state-dependent application revision while preserving the exact 8/16/20/8 policy.

model-generation.summary: Localized the campaign-v1 analyzer wire repair by deriving each ownership record's passed field from its executed named checks; SysML typechecking and the complete bounded analyzer passed with source, metrics, and traceability unchanged.

visualization.summary: Validated 18-edge overview passed machine, native-resolution, sidecar, and complete traceability review.

designer-final.summary: Source-bound design, owner-local semantics, bounded analysis, traceability, and rendered overview all pass; executable evidence is not required and remains not run.
